body: Fact (Opus2 #6931, read-only check, recorded by Fable2 2026-11-19 ~11:10Z): TermAl has NO build.rs and no UI embedding. src/main.rs run_server serves ui/dist straight from disk (ServeDir on cwd/ui/dist, with index.html as the fallback). ui/dist is git-ignored (.gitignore /ui/dist), so Greg's `git pull` + `cargo run --release` NEVER refreshes the UI. Whenever landed commits touch ui/src, the restart request to Greg must add, from the repository root: `cd ui && npm run build` (the script is tsc --noEmit && vite build; run `npm ci` first only if dependencies changed), then a browser reload. Rebuilding ui/dist is a live change, so agents don't do it; it is Greg's step in the restart request. As of 11:08Z the served ui/dist was from 2026-11-17 16:54:55Z, stale against 2A84 (1df3b3f1).
